🛠 Notice 🛠

This script is currently in beta. Updates and changes are expected. If you encounter any bugs, have questions, or would like to suggest new features, we’d love to hear from you.

Join our Discord server for support, bug reports, previews, suggestions, and more!


ROLLING

- auto roll, adjustable delay
- equip best slime automatically on each roll
- hidden roll, hides the roll animation
- pause golden, diamond, and void special rolls individually
- live session stats, rolls per minute

WEBHOOK

- discord webhook url setup
- user id for pings on rare rolls
- adjustable send cooldown 
- test webhook button
- log rolls with min rarity filter
- log all toggle, bypasses the rarity filter
- ping user toggle
- optional session stats in the embed

FARMING

- auto buy next zone, adjustable cap
- teleport to any zone instantly
- auto collect loot, adjustable collection delay
- adjustable walk speed
- infinite jump

UPGRADES

- auto buy upgrades, adjustable delay
- choose which upgrades to prioritise from the full upgrade list
- buy all upgrades at once button
- live display showing how many upgrades are maxed

REBIRTH

- auto rebirth, adjustable goop threshold percentage
- rebirth cap to stop at a set number
- min zone requirement before rebirthing
- manual rebirth now button
- live rebirth info showing goop, cost and luck multiplier

SLIMES

- auto equip best slimes, adjustable interval
- equip best now button
- equip a specific slime by name
- auto use luck potions, ultra luck and roll speed potions
- auto claim index rewards with adjustable interval
- auto feed food to slimes, priority by least xp, most xp or random, choose which food items to use, adjustable delay

MISC

- noclip
- anti afk
- live session stats, uptime, rolls, rebirths and zones
- unload script

scripts.title: Forge Hub | Autofarm, Auto Hatch, Auto Boosts & More
scripts.features:
🛠 Notice 🛠

This script is currently in beta. Updates and changes are expected. If you encounter any bugs, have questions, or would like to suggest new features, we’d love to hear from you.

Join our Discord server for support, bug reports, previews, suggestions, and more!

FEATURES:



AUTO FARM

-auto farm (tick rate 1-20/s, targets per tick 1-30, type filter: coins/diamond/vip/chest/pinata/lucky/boss/mythical/secret)

-stay in zone, target zone picker, teleport to zone

-auto equip best pets on interval (15-300s), anti-afk

COLLECT

-auto collect orbs (range 20-2000, tick rate 1-30/s, combine orbs)

-auto collect lootbags (range 50-3000)

-auto hidden presents, auto exclusive eggs (pickup range 50-5000)

-auto pop balloons

EVENTS

-auto lucky raid (cooldown 1-60s)

-auto comet shower, auto chest roulette, auto minefield

-auto spin (wheel picker, cooldown 1-120s)

-auto time trial, auto lucky blocks, auto block party

EGGS

-auto buy and hatch (egg picker, quantity x1/x3/x8, rate 1-10/s, auto teleport to egg), hatch once now

-charged hatch, golden hatch

-teleport to selected egg, refresh egg list

-auto open exclusive eggs (rate 1-10/s), lucky roll

PETS

-equip best pets, restore saved team, unequip all pets, auto equip toggle

-visual dupe hotfix, respawn pets, restore pets

-auto re-equip on interval (10-300s)

PROGRESSION

-auto rebirth (cooldown 2-60s), rebirth now

-auto claim rank rewards, claim all now

-auto npc quests (category filter: elemental/farming/woodcutting)

-auto claim mailbox, auto daily rewards, auto login streak

BOOSTS

-auto use potions (multi-select potion type, rate 1-8/s, skip if already active)

-auto eat fruits (multi-select fruit type, rate 1-8/s, skip if already active)

-auto claim free gifts, claim all now

TELEPORT

-world 1/2/3/4, trading plaza, main world

-zone picker, teleport to zone

-machine picker, teleport to machine

CODES

-redeem all built-in codes, type a code in chat to auto-redeem it

PLAYER

-speed (16-200), jump (50-500), gravity (10-300), infinite jump, noclip

-reset character, save/load position

-fullbright, hide other players, hide pets

MISC

-server hop, move server, rejoin

-low detail mode

-session stats (breakable hits, eggs hatched, orbs collected, codes ok/fail, session time)

SETTINGS

-save/load config (5 slots, auto load on start)

-ui size (small/default/large/mobile), toggle keybind, toggle ui, unload hub
